<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="nex-angel-of-death-basic" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Nex, Angel of Death Basic</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/JChZfA1i4S.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The aim of this guide is provide a basic overview of how to get consistent kills at Nex, Angel of Death with a low-tier geared team. While writing this guide, we aimed to keep each preset within the confines of tier 1 of </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki>. However due to the endgame nature of the boss, this has not been totally possible. Keeping this in mind, we have instead aimed to provide presets that are as low-tiered as possible without consistent strategies becoming unviable.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="disclaimer"><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide is made with the idea of getting started at AoD, and does not cover meta strategies. For those please refer to the main guides in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#angel-of-death-7s</nowiki></span><nowiki>. For a detailed description of mechanics, please refer to </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="magic"><ins><nowiki>Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Magic is both the cheapest and the easiest style to use at AoD. Provided below are presets and strategies for various roles while using the magic combat style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="magic-base"><nowiki>Magic Base</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Kill Breakdown</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>These are merely guidelines. Adjust as necessary based on your own skill and team.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pre-Start</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Wait for all 6 other team members to join the instance. Then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Place 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the Cruor quadrant. Build back to 100 and start the fight at ~25s on your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the boss. Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> till the boss phases at 2.1m hp.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Build adrenaline while Nex is unattackable.
​⬥ Once she is damageable again use strong abilities on her until she reaches close to 1.8m hp.
​⬥ Help kill the Glacies and Cruor amalgamations. Ideally use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during this phase on one of the amalgamations.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and build adrenaline until you are able to use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Lure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ASAP just before she hits 600k hp. Use strong abilities to phase her if required.
​⬥ Once she is lured, apply </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and build between last pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Pre-</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> last pillar before team arrives.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="magic-minion-tank"><nowiki>Magic Minion Tank</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Kill Breakdown</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>These are merely guidelines. Adjust as necessary based on your own skill and team.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pre-Start</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with your base and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Build back to 100 and wait till your base starts the fight. Place 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in your respective quadrant.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1" alt="impactflank" title="impactflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153611018261.png?v=1" alt="deepimpactflank" title="deepimpactflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> till the boss phases at 2.1m hp.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Run to your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spot and lose target to centre it. Instructions on losing target provided below:
    • Drop </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → any basic ability on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → disassemble </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → any offensive ability → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • If using queueing replace any offensive ability with an eof spec instead
​⬥ Throw a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the amalgamation spot just before it spawns. Release </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once amalgamations spawn and use strong abilities till she is almost at 1.8m hp.
    • It is beneficial to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while standing behind the amalgamation for this step, so as to help phase </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>and</nowiki></em><nowiki> kill the amalgamation.
​⬥ Kill your amalgamation.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Once your minion has spawned and is aggro'd onto you, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> across the centre of the arena to lure it to the centre.
​⬥ Once this is done, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and build adrenaline until you are able to use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1" alt="impactflank" title="impactflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153611018261.png?v=1" alt="deepimpactflank" title="deepimpactflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the first pillar just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reaches 600k hp.
​⬥ Use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on each pillar, then kill them using your strong abilities as available.
​⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary to move between pillars or to the middle to pick up bombs. Aim to exit the 3rd pillar with 100% adren or close to it.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> between last pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678154369400862.png?v=1" alt="impactflank" title="impactflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153611018261.png?v=1" alt="deepimpactflank" title="deepimpactflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pre-Start</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with your base and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Build back to 100 and wait till your base starts the fight. Place 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the Umbra quadrant.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> till the boss phases at 2.1m hp.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Run to the Umbra </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spot and lose target to centre it. Instructions on losing target provided below:
    • Drop </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → any basic ability on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → disassemble </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → any offensive ability → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • If using queueing replace any offensive ability with an eof spec instead
​⬥ Release </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once amalgamations spawn and use strong abilities till she is almost at 1.8m hp.
    • It is beneficial to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while standing behind the amalgamation for this step, so as to help phase </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>and</nowiki></em><nowiki> kill the amalgamation.
​⬥ Help kill the Umbra and Fumus amalgamations.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Build adrenaline and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the south centre line. Then use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the first pillar just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reaches 600k hp.
​⬥ Use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on each pillar, then kill them using your strong abilities as available.
​⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary to move between pillars or to the middle to pick up bombs. Aim to exit the 3rd pillar with 100% adren or close to it.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> between last pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869285393223254107.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="ranged"><ins><nowiki>Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ranged is the most expensive style to use at AoD even at an entry level due to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This style scales much better at higher levels of investment, and will see large improvements in performance with upgrades such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412865523722.png?v=1" alt="eofpink" title="eofpink" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1" alt="decimation" title="decimation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be taken for minion damage, with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1" alt="decimation" title="decimation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> being a highly effective combo for AoD damage as well.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>These are merely guidelines. Adjust as necessary based on your own skill and team.

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with your base and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Build back to 100 and wait till your base starts the fight. Place 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in your respective quadrant.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> till the boss phases at 2.1m hp. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, if available, whenever off cooldown.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Once amalgamations have spawned, use strong abilities until </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is almost at 1.8m hp.
​⬥ Proceed to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and kill your amalgamation. It is beneficial to save your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for this step.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Once your minion has spawned and is aggro'd onto you, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> across the centre of the arena to lure it to the centre.
​⬥ As you are doing this, build </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if available, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and build adrenaline until you are able to use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1" alt="decimation" title="decimation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if available.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the first pillar just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reaches 600k hp.
​⬥ Kill the pillars using your strong abilities as available.
​⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary to move between pillars or to the middle to pick up bombs. Aim to exit the 3rd pillar with 100% adren or close to it.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> between last pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>

Then use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1" alt="decimation" title="decimation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if available.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the first pillar just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reaches 600k hp.
​⬥ Kill the pillars using your strong abilities as available.
​⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary to move between pillars or to the middle to pick up bombs. Aim to exit the 3rd pillar with 100% adren or close to it.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> between last pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as much as possible in between.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>These are merely guidelines. Adjust as necessary based on your own skill and team.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pre-Start</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with your base and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1" alt="DBA" title="DBA" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Build back to 100 and wait till your base starts the fight. Place 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in your respective quadrant.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the boss once attackable. Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153866870824.png?v=1" alt="fbackhandflank" title="fbackhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1" alt="backhandflank" title="backhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while rotating good basics. Do this until the boss phases at 2.1m hp.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Build adren with basics while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is undamageable. Use your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626465964325601290.png?v=1" alt="zgs" title="zgs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the ZGS spot.
​⬥ Cease attacking the boss to charge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Once </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is damageable, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and bleed a channeled ability.
​⬥ Run to your ZGS spot and equip your halberd weapon. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki> so that they hit both your amalgamation and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. (</nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/hxsLd6u.mp4 <nowiki>ZGS Example Clip</nowiki>]<nowiki>)
​⬥ Once </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is almost at 1.8m hp, proceed to finish killing your amalgamation.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Once your minion has spawned and is aggro'd onto you, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> across the centre of the arena to lure it to the centre.
​⬥ Once this is done, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153866870824.png?v=1" alt="fbackhandflank" title="fbackhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1" alt="backhandflank" title="backhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while rotating good basics.
​⬥ If your chinner requires assistance clearing the minions, you may swap to your halberd weapon for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the first pillar just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reaches 600k hp.
​⬥ Kill the pillars using your strong abilities as available.
​⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary to move between pillars or to the middle to pick up bombs. Aim to exit the 3rd pillar with 100% adren or close to it.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Once at the last pillar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153866870824.png?v=1" alt="fbackhandflank" title="fbackhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1" alt="backhandflank" title="backhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while rotating good basics until both the pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are dead.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>

(</nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/hxsLd6u.mp4 <nowiki>ZGS Example Clip</nowiki>]<nowiki>)
​⬥ Once </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is almost at 1.8m hp, proceed to help kill the Umbra and Fumus amalgamations.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Run to the south centre line and build adrenaline while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is undamageable.
​⬥ Once she becomes damageable, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153866870824.png?v=1" alt="fbackhandflank" title="fbackhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1" alt="backhandflank" title="backhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while rotating good basics.
​⬥ If your chinner requires assistance clearing the minions, you may swap to your halberd weapon for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879506309150.png?v=1" alt="quake" title="quake" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the first pillar just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reaches 600k hp.
​⬥ Kill the pillars using your strong abilities as available.
​⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary to move between pillars or to the middle to pick up bombs. Aim to exit the 3rd pillar with 100% adren or close to it.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Once at the last pillar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153866870824.png?v=1" alt="fbackhandflank" title="fbackhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153854025779.png?v=1" alt="backhandflank" title="backhandflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while rotating good basics until both the pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are dead.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="necromancy"><nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Necromancy is currently one of the best styles in general at AoD, and it can be used both at entry level and at the high end.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics_3"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=E2RrdIw8D2PW2AYYFOHL <nowiki>Necromancy - Minion Tank/Free/Hammer</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FE2RrdIw8D2PW2AYYFOHL.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="necromancy-minion-tankfreehammer"><nowiki>Necromancy Minion Tank/Free/Hammer</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Kill Breakdown</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>These are merely guidelines. Adjust as necessary based on your own skill and team.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pre-Start</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1" alt="commandghost" title="commandghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandwarrior" title="commandwarrior" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before the boss spawns. Place 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in your respective quadrant if reavers are expected.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the boss once attackable. Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1" alt="omniguard" title="omniguard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1156683164593430579.png?v=1" alt="soulstrikeflank" title="soulstrikeflank" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>  while rotating good basics. Do this until the boss phases at 2.1m hp. Hammer should use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1" alt="ingen" title="ingen" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Special Attack as the first ability on the boss. 
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Build adren and Residual Souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with basics while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is undamageable.
​⬥ Command Skeleton </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandwarrior" title="commandwarrior" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before the boss becomes damageable and use strong abilities to phase it.
​⬥ AOD </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will phase at 1.8m hp. 
​⬥ The Necromancy base will kill the amalgamations using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (assuming Soulbound Lantern </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1" alt="soulboundlantern" title="soulboundlantern" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and 3/4+ Residual Souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki>).
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Lure your minion by surging through </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ This is a good time to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1" alt="livingdeath" title="livingdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> →  </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandwarrior" title="commandwarrior" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Once minions are lured, you can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to kill the minions and do good damage to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Pillars</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the first pillar just before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reaches 600k hp.
​⬥ Kill the pillars using your strong abilities as available, such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (which can be bounced between pillars if timed correctly).
​⬥ Split Soul </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used safely on pillars 2-3 if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is lured into the fourth correctly. 
​⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary to move between pillars or to the middle to pick up bombs. Aim to exit the 3rd pillar 4/5 Residual Souls </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> so you can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Last Pillar and Zaros</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Once at the last pillar </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (if you are confident in bouncing it onto </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.
​⬥ Use your strong abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1" alt="omniguard" title="omniguard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while rotating good basics until both the pillar and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580167371365548042.png?v=1" alt="aod" title="aod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are dead.
​⬥ Deal with bombs as well as you can, making sure to place them away from your team.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
